subject: SparrowTech onboarding: PO mapping, provisional PO and spend cap adjustments
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@sparrowtech.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SparrowTech onboarding: PO mapping, provisional PO and spend cap adjustments

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the kickoff call this morning. To keep the onboarding moving, Procurement needs a couple of items from SparrowTech so we can issue the PO and open the spend band:

1) Completed onboarding spreadsheet (attached) with line items mapped to your SKU/description. Please use the template column headers: Redwood SKU, Sparrow SKU, Description, Unit, Unit price, Billing cadence.
2) Confirmation of the total quarterly spend cap you want Redwood to reserve during the first 90 days (we typically set a provisional reserve until billing normalizes).
3) W9 and a point-of-contact for invoicing (email + phone).

We can issue a provisional PO number for onboarding if you need it immediately — procurement usually issues a provisional PO in the format PO-26-####-P, then converts to the final PO after the first invoice is validated. If you confirm line item mapping and the spend cap, Priyom will create the provisional PO and route for Laura's approval.

Target timeline: updated onboarding form + invoice draft by EOD Wed (11/4) so we can have a provisional PO before the end of next week.

Attaching: SparrowTech_onboarding_form.xlsx (please return completed).

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Vendor Ops Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@sparrowtech.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sparrowtech.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 11:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SparrowTech onboarding: PO mapping, provisional PO and spend cap adjustments

Diego —

Thanks for the clear notes. I've attached an initial invoice draft (SparrowTech_invoice_v1.xlsx) and a filled onboarding sheet with our suggested SKU mappings. A couple quick Qs before we finalize:

- Line item: "Dedicated Burstable Capacity" — is that billed as a single line or split between reserved and burst? Our invoice currently lists it as one combined line.
- Spend cap: we proposed $75,000 / quarter in the onboarding sheet. Is that ok for a provisional reserve?

Attached: SparrowTech_onboarding_form.xlsx (completed), SparrowTech_invoice_v1.xlsx.

Also attaching W9 (SparrowTech_W9.pdf) per your request. If you want us to make the invoice reference the provisional PO number you issue, let me know the placeholder format.

Best,
Alex Ramos
Head of Finance Ops
SparrowTech

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@sparrowtech.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SparrowTech onboarding: PO mapping, provisional PO and spend cap adjustments

Alex / team —

Thanks for the uploads — I reviewed your invoice and the onboarding sheet. A few line-item corrections we need before issuing a provisional PO:

- Split the "Dedicated Burstable Capacity" into two lines: INF-DED-RES (Reserved capacity hours) and INF-DED-BST (Burst credits). Redwood requires separate ledger codes to track reserved commit vs burst consumption.
- Add Redwood SKU column values exactly as in the template so AP can match invoices automatically (e.g., INF-DED-RES -> SKU INF-DED-RES).
- For tax/invoice header: please add "Invoice to: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Payable, PO: <provisional PO here>" on every invoice page.

Assuming the updated invoice matches the mapping, Procurement will create a provisional PO in our system: PO-26-4587-P (the trailing "-P" is provisional). That provisional PO will hold a reserved spend cap of $75,000 for the first 90 days while we reconcile the first two invoices. Laura will route the provisional for final approval. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROCV-412 (routing/approval workflow).

Please attach the revised invoice (SparrowTech_invoice_v2.xlsx) and confirm you want the provisional PO referenced on the DocuSign purchase agreement.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sr. Procurement Analyst
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@sparrowtech.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@sparrowtech.com
Date: Wed, 04 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SparrowTech onboarding: PO mapping, provisional PO and spend cap adjustments

Priyom / Diego —

Thanks — we updated the invoice and split the line items per your mapping. New file attached: SparrowTech_invoice_v2.xlsx. W9 included as well (SparrowTech_W9.pdf).

We also started the DocuSign for the Master Services Agreement and added a field for the PO. DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/link/abc123 (placeholder).

Question: once you create the provisional PO (PO-26-4587-P), do you want us to sign the DocuSign using the provisional PO value or wait for the final PO? We can add the provisional PO on the DocuSign if that speeds onboarding.

Best,
Alex Ramos
Head of Finance Ops
SparrowTech

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Ramos <alex.ramos@sparrowtech.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: SparrowTech onboarding: PO mapping, provisional PO and spend cap adjustments

Alex —

Appreciate the quick turnaround on the invoice and onboarding sheet. Procurement finalized the provisional flow and we've decided to convert to the final PO before you sign DocuSign to keep AP headers clean. Final details below:

- Provisional PO (internal): PO-26-4587-P — used internally while first invoice is validated.
- Final PO (to be used on signed contracts and invoices): PO-26-4587 (no "-P").
- Reserved spend cap: $75,000 (quarterly) — Procurement will monitor consumption and lift the provisional flag after the second invoice reconciliation.

I've attached the final PO document (PO-26-4587.pdf) for your records. Please update the DocuSign to reference PO-26-4587 on the signature page and return the signed agreement. AP will match invoices against the final PO once the provisional is cleared.

If anything changes on your side (pricing or SKU mapping), loop me in before final signature so we can avoid a contract amendment.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Vendor Ops Manager
Redwood Inference
Attachment: PO-26-4587.pdf
